digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria routing and T10 infra gate
propositions: T3 and T10 criteria must transition from non-blocking to blocking posture with conservative 0.90 block_threshold pilot through criteria_routing.json configuration

T10 blocking scope is constrained to MAJOR-class findings (destructive apply, wildcard/overbroad grant, plaintext secret, unauthenticated internet-reachable service) via severity guidance in plan_review_T10.md rubric
T10 DetGateRule with infra-vocabulary regex (terraform, cloudformation, kubernetes, aws services, IAC keywords, GitHub workflows) must pre-gate T10 routing on infrastructure and IaC touching plans
Pinned routing table and approved-blocking-criteria assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py and test_impact_model_versioning.py must be updated to reflect T3/T10 blocking promotion
T3 and T10 findings crossing 0.90 priority threshold must produce blocking decisions in Pass-3 while findings below threshold remain advisory
